mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.user_id, p.display_name, p.avatar_url, p.role_text, p.bio, p.status_label, p.status_text, p.status_emoji, p.created_at, p.updated_at, p.version FROM profile p INNER JOIN space_user u ON u.id = p.user_id WHERE u.role = 'OWNER' AND u.deleted = 0 ORDER BY p.id LIMIT 1
SELECT id, user_id, display_name, avatar_url, role_text, bio, status_label, status_text, status_emoji, created_at, updated_at, version FROM profile WHERE user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE profile SET display_name = #{profile.displayName}, avatar_url = #{profile.avatarUrl}, role_text = #{profile.roleText}, bio = #{profile.bio}, status_label = #{profile.statusLabel}, status_text = #{profile.statusText}, status_emoji = #{profile.statusEmoji}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{profile.id} AND version = #{version}
